title_zh: 摘自一本被水浸透的日记

lines.en: label halloweenfour10:
scene confessional1
An excerpt from a waterlogged journal:
lines.zh: 摘自一本被水浸透的日记：

lines.en: I have always been afraid of death. I think about it more than I probably should.
lines.zh: 我一直都怕死。我想这件事想得比大概该想的还要多。

lines.en: I have spent half of my life wondering if other people are plagued by these thoughts as well.
lines.zh: 我花了半辈子去琢磨，别人是不是也被这些念头折磨着。

lines.en: I do not believe they are- for I have felt nothing short of alone even when surrounded by those who claim to love me.
lines.zh: 我不相信他们是——因为即便被那些声称爱我的人环绕，我感受到的也只有孤独。

lines.en: I have grown accustomed to these feelings. I have accepted them as a part of me, albeit one that I am afraid to make known.
lines.zh: 我已经习惯了这些感受。我接受了它们是我的一部分，尽管是我害怕让人知道的那一部分。

lines.en: Are you also afraid of death?
lines.zh: 你也怕死吗？

lines.en: If you are, I promise you won't need to be anymore.
lines.zh: 如果你怕，我向你保证，你再也不需要怕了。

lines.en: I have created a world where everyone is happy.
lines.zh: 我创造了一个每个人都幸福的世界。

lines.en: It is an ordinary world where kind faces greet one another with smiles and laughter.
lines.zh: 那是一个平凡的世界，善良的面孔用微笑和笑声彼此问候。

lines.en: Its inhabitants live normal lives, untouched by the evils of the outside world. They do not fear death here; they do not fear anything. They have no need to.
lines.zh: 它的居民过着正常的生活，不被外界的邪恶所触及。他们在这里不惧怕死亡；他们什么都不怕。他们没有理由去怕。

lines.en: All they need to do is stay where they are and everything will be okay.
lines.zh: 他们只需要待在原地，一切就会好起来。

lines.en: I promise you that everything is going to be okay.
lines.zh: 我向你保证，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: All you need to do is stay here with us.
lines.zh: 你只需要留在这里，和我们在一起。

lines.en: Please do not go anywhere else.
lines.zh: 请别去别的任何地方。

lines.en: (LINE BREAK)
lines.zh: (LINE BREAK)

lines.en: I had a dream of a girl with blue eyes last night.
lines.zh: 昨晚我梦见了一个蓝眼睛的女孩。

lines.en: I did that thing where you try to go back to sleep after waking up to see if I could see her again, but it didn’t work.
lines.zh: 我试了那种醒来后再睡回去的办法，想看看能不能再见到她，但没成功。

lines.en: I never even got her name.
lines.zh: 我连她的名字都没问到。

lines.en: I guess that doesn’t really matter though.
lines.zh: 不过我想那也无所谓。

lines.en: A dream is just a dream after all.
lines.zh: 梦终究只是梦。

lines.en: And no matter how hard you wish for one to become true, the fact remains that it’ll likely be gone with the setting of the sun or...I don’t know. Something else that goes away too fast.
lines.zh: 而且不管你多拼命地希望它成真，事实依然是它很可能随着日落就消失了……或者，我不知道。某个同样消逝得太快的东西。

lines.en: It’s Tuesday, so that means it’s Yuko’s turn to make dinner.
lines.zh: 今天是星期二，所以轮到 Yuko 做晚饭。

lines.en: And I use the term “dinner” lightly because I’m pretty sure all we have left are garlic bread and that cake Ai’s been saving for a “special occasion.”
lines.zh: 而我用了「晚饭」这个词其实挺心虚的，因为我敢肯定我们只剩下蒜香面包，还有 Ai 一直留着等「特别场合」的那块蛋糕。

lines.en: I’m not sure what she expects to happen, exactly. We’re not really privy to “special occasions” in this house. And unless one of our birthdays is coming up (Which I have not kept track of), that leaves pretty much-
lines.zh: 我不太确定她到底在期待什么。这栋屋子里真没什么「特别场合」可言。除非有谁的生日快到了（而我根本没在记），那基本就剩下——

lines.en: Well...nothing.
lines.zh: 嗯……什么都没有。

lines.en: There’s never anything to look forward to here.
lines.zh: 这里从来没有什么值得期待的事。

lines.en: But I guess that’s why I’ve been putting so much emphasis on my dreams lately.
lines.zh: 但我想这就是为什么我最近这么看重我的梦。

lines.en: On that girl with blue eyes.
lines.zh: 那么看重那个蓝眼睛的女孩。

lines.en: scene black
scene confessional3
: Kyoko? What are you doing? I thought you were going to take a shower?
lines.zh: Kyoko？你在干什么？我还以为你要去洗澡？

lines.en: : I was! But then I decided not to. Figured that might keep you on your toes and remind you of how {i}unpredictable{/i} and {i}exciting{/i} I am.
lines.zh: 我本来是要去的！但后来我决定不去了。想着这样能让你时刻保持紧张，提醒你我有多{i}不可预测{/i}、多{i}刺激{/i}。

lines.en: : And what’s so exciting about not taking a shower, exactly?
lines.zh: 不洗澡到底有什么好刺激的？

lines.en: : The fact that we can now take one {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为现在我们可以{i}一起{/i}洗了。

lines.en: : Well, that {i}would{/i} be better for the water bill. But I’d run the risk of having you use up the last of my conditioner again, so...I will respectfully decline.
lines.zh: 那{i}确实{/i}对水费更友好。但我得冒着你又把我的护发素用光的险，所以……我敬谢不敏。

lines.en: : You never let me have any fun anymore. I want a divorce.
lines.zh: 你现在越来越不让我开心了。我要离婚。

lines.en: : Funny. I don’t remember marrying you.
lines.zh: 真好笑。我不记得我娶过你。

lines.en: : That’s not funny at all. That’s sad. Our wedding was a beautiful one with blue hydrangeas, boiled squid, and-
lines.zh: 那一点都不好笑。那很可悲。我们的婚礼很美，有蓝色绣球花、水煮鱿鱼，还有——

lines.en: : And one rather irritating lesbian who needs to learn that she can’t just keep herself entertained by pestering her roommates all day.
lines.zh: 还有一个相当烦人的女同性恋，她得学会不能整天靠烦室友来自娱自乐。

lines.en: : I can and I will. You just watch.
lines.zh: 我能，而且我会。你就看着吧。

lines.en: scene confessional4
: I can and I will.
lines.zh: 我能，而且我会。

lines.en: The excerpt ends here and, as you read the final words, the sheet of paper dissolves in your hands, turning into the same strain of pink sand you can only find on Bermudian beaches.
lines.zh: 摘录到这里就结束了，而当你读完最后几个字，那张纸在你手中溶解，化作只有在百慕大海滩才能找到的那种粉色沙子。

lines.en: Your right foot, completely uncovered, stretches outward to explore it. You wiggle your toes, letting the sand fall beneath and between them. It’s grainy, but pleasant in a way you can’t quite describe.
lines.zh: 你完全裸露的右脚伸出去探索它。你扭动脚趾，让沙子从趾下与趾间流过。它很粗糙，却有一种你难以形容的舒适感。

lines.en: It’s a nostalgic feeling. You remember visiting the beach with your parents when you were younger. And how you always hated wearing sunscreen, but they made you do it anyway so you would live longer.
lines.zh: 那是一种怀旧的感觉。你想起小时候跟父母去海边的日子。想起你有多讨厌涂防晒霜，可他们还是逼你涂，好让你活得更久。

lines.en: You remember the scent. That chemically produced protective coating that wasn’t quite {i}sweet,{/i} yet there were no other adjectives that felt correct to attach to it.
lines.zh: 你记得那个味道。那层化学合成的防护涂层，算不上{i}甜{/i}，可又没有别的形容词配得上它。

lines.en: scene confessional5
You were never enough for anyone. That’s why you spent so much time inside of your head.
lines.zh: 你对任何人来说都不够好。所以你才总活在自己的脑子里。

lines.en: Even today, you struggle to find other humans who can properly understand you.
lines.zh: 即便到了今天，你依然很难找到能真正理解你的人。

lines.en: This leads to you burning bridges and dismantling once-important connections over misunderstandings and the fact that your brain just acts a little silly sometimes.
lines.zh: 这让你因为一些误会、因为你脑子有时候就是有点犯蠢，而烧掉一座座桥、拆掉一段段曾经重要的关系。

lines.en: Even today, you are not enough. That’s why you remember those beaches. That’s why the scent of sunscreen still clings to the mucus in your nasal passages. It’s why it won’t ever leave.
lines.zh: 即便到了今天，你依然不够好。所以你才记得那些海滩。所以防晒霜的气味还黏在你鼻腔的黏液里。所以它永远不会散去。

lines.en: You feel so much.
lines.zh: 你感受到的太多了。

lines.en: That’s why I like you.
lines.zh: 所以我才喜欢你。

lines.en: I like how you never grew up.
lines.zh: 我喜欢你永远长不大。

lines.en: I like how you still cry over the simplest things. And how you try to hide it because you learned from bigger people that’s what you’re meant to do.
lines.zh: 我喜欢你还会为最简单的事掉眼泪。还有你试着藏起来，因为你从大人们那里学会了「就该这么做」。

lines.en: I have a confession to make.
lines.zh: 我有件事要坦白。

lines.en: scene confessional7
i tried to bite off my tongue
lines.zh: 我试着把自己的舌头咬下来

: Ladies and gentlemen — may I have your attention?
lines.zh: 女士们先生们——能听我说几句吗？

lines.en: : It is at this point in time that I would like to welcome my fellow classmates to come forward and confess their sins to Sister Nodoka.
lines.zh: 此刻，我想请在座的各位同学上前来，向 Nodoka 修女忏悔你们的罪。

lines.en: : Through me, you can be forgiven. And all of your misdeeds or sins will be forgotten in the eyes of whichever god you follow, for I have been ordained by the world itself.
lines.zh: 通过我，你们可以得到宽恕。无论你们追随哪位神明，你们的一切过失与罪孽都将被遗忘，因为我已受世界本身的祝圣。

lines.en: : Hold nothing back. Confess to me the full, heinous truths you have kept secret from others. And revel in knowing that they’ll be washed away for you to start anew.
lines.zh: 什么都别藏着。向我坦白你们对旁人守着的、那些穷凶极恶的真相。并在知晓它们会被洗净、让你们重新开始之中欢欣吧。

lines.en: scene confessional9
: A new beginning is exactly what most of you need, is it not?
lines.zh: 重新开始正是你们大多数人需要的，不是吗？

lines.en: : A chance for you to carry the parts of yourself you cherish into a new life, while bidding goodbye to the impurities and infectious memories that plague your mind like locusts.
lines.zh: 一个机会，让你把珍视的那部分自己带进新的人生，同时告别那些像蝗虫一样折磨你心灵的污秽与传染性的记忆。

lines.en: : Come forward! Confess! Gaze into my eyes and have those infections consumed! Be born again!
lines.zh: 上前来！忏悔吧！凝视我的双眼，让那些感染被吞噬！重生吧！

lines.en: : I think I’m going to be sick...
lines.zh: 我想我要吐了……

lines.en: : Yasu, what have you done to Nodoka? She’s turning into {i}you{/i} all of a sudden.
lines.zh: Yasu，你对 Nodoka 做了什么？她突然变得像{i}你{/i}了。

lines.en: : Yasu? Hello?
lines.zh: Yasu？喂？

lines.en: : Something is happening...
lines.zh: 有什么事要发生了……

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: 我觉得……

lines.en: : I think the city is...
lines.zh: 我觉得这座城市在……

lines.en: : Moving...
lines.zh: 移动……

lines.en: : Nodoka, nobody wants to confess anything to you. You’re creepy and probably going to touch yourself to it.
lines.zh: Nodoka，没人想跟你忏悔什么。你很变态，而且八成会对着那些东西自慰。

lines.en: scene confessional10

: I would do no such thing, blessed child. This body is a temple and, with {b}God{/i} as my witness, I’d never do {i}anything{/i} to defile it. I simply wish to lend my aid and become your spiritual guide.
lines.zh: 我绝不会做那种事，蒙福的孩子。这具身体是一座圣殿，以{b}上帝{/i}为证，我绝不会做任何{i}亵渎{/i}它的事。我只是想伸出援手，成为你们的精神导师。

lines.en: : I think I’m going to side with Ami here. It would be one thing if Sana or somebody innocent dressed up as a nun. This just seems like a fetish thingy for you.
lines.zh: 这件事我站 Ami。如果是 Sana 或者什么单纯的人打扮成修女，那还说得过去。这看起来纯粹就是你的性癖玩意儿。

lines.en: : I...would prefer to...not dress like that...
lines.zh: 我……还是……不太想……穿成那样……

lines.en: : You are all free to do as you please.
lines.zh: 你们尽可以随心所欲。

lines.en: scene confessional11
: I’d never do anything that robs someone of a {i}choice.{/i} And if it is your choice to abstain from salvation, I will not hold it against you.
lines.zh: 我绝不会做任何剥夺别人{i}选择{/i}的事。如果你们选择放弃救赎，我不会因此记恨你们。

lines.en: : All I want to do is {i}help.{/i}
lines.zh: 我只想{i}帮忙{/i}。

lines.en: : No...all {i}you{/i} want to do is hear everyone’s stories so you can take them and {i}make them your own.{/i}
lines.zh: 不……{i}你{/i}想做的只是听每个人的故事，然后拿走它们，{i}变成你自己的{/i}。

lines.en: : How is one to {i}forgive{/i} if one can not {i}understand?{/i} As a woman of the cloth, I must shoulder the burden of all things so as to properly communicate these struggles to our holy Father.
lines.zh: 一个人若不能{i}理解{/i}，又如何{i}宽恕{/i}？作为一名神职人员，我必须承担起一切的重负，才能把这些苦难如实传达给我们圣洁的天父。

lines.en: : Rin, don’t even think about going up there.
lines.zh: Rin，你想都别想上去。

lines.en: : Me? Why would {i}I{/i} go up there? I’m a good girl. I have nothing to hide.
lines.zh: 我？为什么{i}我{/i}要上去？我是个好女孩。我没什么好藏的。

lines.en: : I...um...don’t really think...Nodoka is...able to...{i}forgive{/i} stuff anyway, so...
lines.zh: 我……嗯……其实不太觉得……Nodoka 有本事……{i}宽恕{/i}什么东西，所以……

lines.en: : What’s your take on this, Yumi?
lines.zh: Yumi，你怎么看？

lines.en: : Fuck does it matter if one more weirdo does some weird shit? Ain’t like this is some kinda surprise. Red-haired uncle fucker was right — she’s probably just gonna get off to whatever people tell her.
lines.zh: 多一个怪人干点怪事有什么他妈关系？这又不算什么意外。那个红毛搞叔叔的说得对——她大概就是靠听别人说的事来获得快感。

lines.en: : Can you {i}not{/i} casually accuse my boyfriend of having sex with his niece? Thanks.
lines.zh: 你能{i}别{/i}随口就指控我男朋友跟他侄女上床吗？谢了。

lines.en: : Take it up with your new {i}co-worker,{/i} not me. She ain’t doin’ herself any favors by verbally ridin’ his dick all day long.
lines.zh: 这话你去跟你的新{i}同事{/i}说，别跟我说。她整天在嘴上骑他那玩意儿，对她自己可没半点好处。

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t blame Ami for wanting to have sex with Sensei. He’s hot. It’s you assuming he’d go for it that I have a problem with.
lines.zh: 嘿，我可不怪 Ami 想跟 Sensei 上床。他很帅。我有意见的是你居然假定他会答应。

lines.en: scene confessional12
: Why do you give that guy so much fucking credit when he ain’t ever done anything to deserve it?
lines.zh: 你为什么对那家伙这么他妈高看一眼？他又没做过什么配得上的事。

lines.en: : Uhh, because that’s what it means to be in love?
lines.zh: 呃，因为这就是恋爱啊？

lines.en: : So being “in love” means turning yourself into a fuckin’ idiot to protect yourself from the truth?
lines.zh: 所以「恋爱」就是把你自己变成个他妈的傻子，好躲开真相？

lines.en: : It means trusting someone with all you have...which I really hope you’re able to do one day.
lines.zh: 意思是把你拥有的一切都托付给某个人……我真的希望有一天你也能做到。

lines.en: : And not just so you can be happy either. It’s mostly so I can brag about how my boyfriend is hotter and has a bigger dick than yours to make up for all the times you’ve trashed Sensei.
lines.zh: 而且还不只是为了让你自己幸福。多半是为了让我能炫耀我男朋友比你的帅、鸡巴比你的大，好补回你埋汰 Sensei 的那一笔笔账。

lines.en: : Then maybe you should go up to Sensei Jr. over there and confess to bein’ a fuckin’ moron. That’s gotta be a sin, right?
lines.zh: 那你不如上那儿去找 Sensei Jr. 忏悔你自己是个他妈的蠢货。那总该算罪吧？

lines.en: scene confessional13

: I don’t think so. I’m pretty sure sinning requires, like...some level of malice or...at least the knowledge that you’re doing something wrong. Like...making out in a church. That’s probably a sin. I think.
lines.zh: 我不这么觉得。我觉得犯罪总得……有点恶意吧……或者至少得知道自己在做错事。比如……在教堂里接吻。那大概是罪。我觉得。

lines.en: scene confessional14
: Oh, or being a fucking bitch to everyone all the time and making them feel bad for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: 哦，或者整天对每个人都他妈刻薄，毫无理由地让别人难受。

lines.en: : Fuck you bringin’ that up for? You know I ain’t doin’ that shit anymore.
lines.zh: 你提这个干什么？你知道我早就不干那种事了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but are you {i}actually{/i} sorry for any of it? Or are you just not antagonizing anybody anymore because it was making life even harder for you?
lines.zh: 是吗，但你{i}真的{/i}为其中任何一件事后悔过吗？还是你只是因为再跟人作对会让你日子更难过，才不再那么干的？

lines.en: : Fuck does it matter so long as nobody’s complaining?
lines.zh: 只要没人抱怨，有什么他妈关系？

lines.en: scene confessional15
: It matters because you’re still unhappy and I hate watching you go through life so fucking miserable.
lines.zh: 有关系，因为你还是不快乐，我他妈最受不了看你这么痛苦地过日子。

lines.en: : I swear, it’s like ever since that Nodoka shit went down, you’ve been totally dead inside. And while some people might see that as {i}growth{/i} since you’re not actively hurting anyone, I think it’s the opposite.
lines.zh: 我发誓，自从 Nodoka 那档子事之后，你整个人就像死了一样。虽然有人可能把这看成{i}成长{/i}，毕竟你不再主动伤害别人了，但我认为恰恰相反。

lines.en: : You’re not going anywhere...and you know it. Because that’s what you {i}want.{/i} And you still won’t even {i}talk{/i} to me about it because you’re the same angry, reclusive girl you’ve always been.
lines.zh: 你哪也去不了……你自己也知道。因为那正是你{i}想要{/i}的。而你到现在还是不肯{i}跟{/i}我谈这件事，因为你还是那个愤怒又孤僻的女孩，一直都是。

lines.en: : That’s just who I fuckin’ am, Chika. I can’t change that.
lines.zh: 我他妈就是这样，Chika。我改不了。

lines.en: scene confessional16
: You can...you just {i}won’t.{/i} So until you decide to let {i}somebody{/i} in, maybe keep that whole “Criticizing everyone’s decisions” stuff to yourself.
lines.zh: 你改得了……你只是{i}不肯{/i}。所以在你决定让{i}某个人{/i}走进来之前，也许那套「批评所有人的决定」的话就先留给你自己吧。

lines.en: : Because, as far as I’m concerned, it’s way more human to choose incorrectly than to just...never choose anything ever.
lines.zh: 因为在我看来，选错了也远比……什么都不选更像个人。

lines.en: : If I play the birthday card, will it get you to stop bitching at me for a minute?
lines.zh: 我要是打出生日牌，能让你闭嘴一分钟吗？

lines.en: : Yumi. Look at me.
lines.zh: Yumi。看着我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I told you to fucking look at me.
lines.zh: 因为我他妈让你看着我。

lines.en: scene confessional17
: There. Now what?
lines.zh: 好了。然后呢？

lines.en: : What’s going on with you? Because I’m really starting to worry that this is bigger than you’re making it out to be.
lines.zh: 你到底怎么了？因为我真的开始担心，这事比你说出来的要严重。

lines.en: : Are you in trouble? Does Nodoka have, like...blackmail on you or some shit? Why are you acting like a fucking...tsundere zombie all the time now?
lines.zh: 你是不是惹上麻烦了？Nodoka 是不是抓了你什么……把柄之类的？你为什么现在整天像个他妈的……傲娇僵尸？
那是……

lines.en: scene confessional18
: It’s hard to-
lines.zh: 那很难—

lines.en: : {i}Look at me.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}看着我。{/i}

lines.en: scene confessional19
: Because it’s fucking hard, okay?! I don’t know how!
lines.zh: 因为这他妈太难了，行了吧？！我不知道该怎么做！

lines.en: scene confessional20
: I ain’t like you.
lines.zh: 我不像你。

lines.en: : I ain’t ever learned about how to “talk it out” or...what kinda shit happens when you let somebody else in on your problems.
lines.zh: 我从来没学过怎么「说出来」，也不知道……让别人知道你的破事之后会发生什么。

lines.en: : I just know that you and everybody else have got a lot goin’ on already and...it ain’t right for me to push all my shit onto you.
lines.zh: 我只知道你和别人都已经有一堆事了，我再把我的破事推给你……不合适。

lines.en: : I just want to, like...forget, okay? I wanna move the fuck on and stop lettin’ stupid shit that happened in the past drag me down. But I ain’t figured out how to do that yet.
lines.zh: 我只想……忘掉，行吗？我想他妈的翻篇，不再让过去发生的蠢事拖着我。可我还没想明白该怎么做。

lines.en: : But what I’ve been trying to tell you this whole time is that’s not something you have to do on your own.
lines.zh: 可我从头到尾想告诉你的就是，这件事你不必一个人扛。

lines.en: : Chika, why the fuck are we doing this here? Can’t you wait until we get back to the dorm to start caring about me and shit?
lines.zh: Chika，我们他妈干嘛要在这儿说这个？你就不能等回宿舍再开始关心我之类的吗？

lines.en: scene confessional21
: I can try.
lines.zh: 我可以试试。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: 我只是……

lines.en: : Something seems...wrong about this. Like...I feel gross and I can’t really explain why. It’s like your aura is contaminating me or something.
lines.zh: 有什么地方……不对劲。就像……我觉得很不舒服，可又说不上来为什么。就像你的气场在污染我之类的。

lines.en: : My {i}aura?{/i}
lines.zh: 我的{i}气场？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. Like, the way you feel.
lines.zh: 对。就是……你给人的感觉。

lines.en: : You’ve spent your whole life afraid of connecting with anyone, so you probably don’t realize some people can pick up on the vibes their loved ones are giving off. And any time Nodoka shows up-
lines.zh: 你一辈子都在害怕跟任何人产生联系，所以你大概不知道，有些人能感知到亲近的人散发出来的气息。而每次 Nodoka 一出现-

lines.en: : You’re a good friend, Chika.
lines.zh: 你是个好朋友，Chika。

lines.en: scene confessional22
: Yumi...
lines.zh: Yumi……

lines.en: : I’m sorry I have to suck so much.
lines.zh: 我很抱歉我非得这么烂。

lines.en: scene black
scene confessional23
: Speak your name, child.
lines.zh: 说出你的名字，孩子。

lines.en: : Kirin Kanda. Please be kind to me, Sister Nodoka. It’s my first ever confession...and I’ve been a {i}very{/i} bad girl.
lines.zh: Kirin Kanda。请对我温柔一点，Nodoka 修女。这是我第一次忏悔……而我一直是个{i}很{/i}坏的女孩。

lines.en: : There is nothing to fear. You’ll be safe so long as you’re in my hands. And everything you tell me will be kept entirely between us, so spare no details at all. No matter how {i}uncomfortable{/i} they may be.
lines.zh: 没什么好怕的。只要在我手里，你就是安全的。你告诉我的一切都只会留在我们之间，所以任何细节都别省略。无论它们有多{i}令人不适{/i}。

lines.en: : Then...it all started when I was eight and walked in on my parents having sex.
lines.zh: 那么……一切要从我八岁那年走进去撞见父母做爱说起。

lines.en: : Aight, you’re done.
lines.zh: 行了，到此为止。

lines.en: scene confessional24
: What? Already? But I haven’t been saved yet!
lines.zh: 什么？这就完了？可我还没被拯救呢！

lines.en: : Girl, I ain’t about to stand here and listen to your weird ass story ‘bout your parents gettin’ down.
lines.zh: 丫头，我可不会站在这儿听你讲你爸妈上床的破事。

lines.en: : Then walk away! Aren’t there rules about...interfering with religious practices or something?
lines.zh: 那就走开啊！不是有规定说……不得干涉宗教活动什么的吗？

lines.en: : There are several rules relating to religious practices in section 7 of the student handbook. And subsection B {i}does{/i} prohibit teachers from interrupting prayer or practices.
lines.zh: 学生手册第 7 章里有好几条涉及宗教活动的规定。其中 B 小节{i}确实{/i}禁止教师打断祈祷或宗教活动。

lines.en: : Fuckin’ Makoto. Do you just sleep with that book taped to your face or something?
lines.zh: 他妈的 Makoto。你是把那本书贴在脸上睡觉还是怎么着？

lines.en: : No. But it’s possible that it’s become so engraved into my psyche after apparently reliving this school year millions of times that I-
lines.zh: 不是。但在显然把这一学年重演了上百万次之后，它可能已经深深镌刻进我的精神里了，所以我-

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. I’m Makoto and I’m smart. Kirin, Nodoka, let go of each other’s hands. If you two want to make out or whatever, go do it in the bathroom like real high schoolers. We ain’t watching.
lines.zh: blah blah blah。我是 Makoto，我很聪明。Kirin，Nodoka，把手松开。你俩要是想接吻什么的，去洗手间，像真正的高中生那样。我们不看。

lines.en: scene confessional25
: I would kind of like to watch.
lines.zh: 我还挺想看的。

lines.en: : Me too. I’ve never witnessed a religious ritual before.
lines.zh: 我也是。我从没见过宗教仪式。

lines.en: : I suppose it can’t be helped. I’ll just have to {i}privately{/i} fill you in on all of the naughty things I’ve done.
lines.zh: 看来是没办法了。那我只能{i}私下{/i}跟你细数我干过的那些下流事了。

lines.en: : If that is what must be done...it will be done.
lines.zh: 若必须如此……那就如此吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Come, Miss Kanda.
lines.zh: 来吧，Kanda 小姐。

lines.en: : Sister Nodoka will show you the way to purity...
lines.zh: Nodoka 修女会为你指明通往纯洁之路……
